name: editor-superengine
description: Raw talking-head recording to a finished reel. It installs and checks its own tools, checks the camera and mic before recording, and the client cuts on the Cut Board and Tweak Board. Then captions, on-screen design and scenes, B-roll, colour, sound and music, a cover, trial reels, and an editable timeline for Resolve. Saved styles carry a client's look from reel to reel, and a style can be decoded from a reel they like. 15 skills, no commands to type.
